verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document per-domain auto-renew toggles, expiry notification emails, or grace and redemption windows for lapsed domains. The only renewal-related item is the Go SDK's RenewWithContext, a one-off, charge-bearing manual renewal call. That is a developer building block, not a recurring auto-renew control. The CEO's 'grace time' remark concerns asking Russian customers to move and is unrelated to domain lapse.

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses
